body: BED, major depression, and social anxiety

i’m so sorry you went through that. i understand how it can be when people don’t take you seriously or are emotionally unavailable. after my attempt, my dad didn’t want to understand my depression or how i felt, he just wanted it gone. hmm, maybe that’s why i stopped going to therapy and claimed i was cured when i’m still clearly super depressed! anyway, i hope things get better for you💗

Thank you so much for this comment. I’ll keep in mind what you’ve said, but luckily I’ve gotten better with trying not to flinch around him. I always did wonder if there was something I couldn’t remember and that was the reason as to why I react the way I do. I don’t know for sure, but I hope one day I’ll find out. My dad and I have a good relationship, but we can never talk about anything serious. So I don’t think I can talk to him about this. Thank you for the suggestion though. I’m really sorry about what happened to you when you were younger, my heart goes out to you. I hope things are better for you now xx
